source: DHM Islamic Studies Level 1 · lesson 22. Exercises reused from the lesson; du'aas flagged for review.
topic: Remembering Allah and the Prophet's ﷺ du'aas for every moment

learn.en: Dhikr means remembering Allah. Du'aa means calling on Him and asking for what we need — and we ask only Allah.
learn.title: Two words, one purpose

learn.en: “Call upon Me; I will respond to you.” (Qur'an 40:60)
learn.title: Allah answers

learn.en: Four phrases of dhikr: Subhan-Allah, Alhamdulillah, La ilaha illallah, Allahu Akbar.
learn.title: Four phrases of dhikr

learn.en: We can make du'aa in our own words, but it is best to use the du'aas the Prophet ﷺ taught us for each moment of the day.
learn.title: A du'aa for every moment

words.en: There is no god but Allah

words.ar: بِسْمِ اللهِ، تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللهِ، وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللهِ
words.en: Leaving home: In the name of Allah, I trust in Allah
words.tr: Bismi-llāh, tawakkaltu ʿala-llāh, wa lā ḥawla wa lā quwwata illā billāh

words.en: Entering the mosque: O Allah, open the gates of Your mercy for me
Leaving the mosque: O Allah, I ask You of Your bounty
Going to bed: In Your name, O Allah, I die and I live

words.ar: الحَمْدُ لِلهِ الَّذِي أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنَا وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ
words.en: Waking up: Praise be to Allah who gave us life again
words.tr: Al-ḥamdu lillāhi lladhī aḥyānā baʿda mā amātanā wa ilayhi n-nushūr

words.en: Hearing a sneeze: May Allah have mercy on you

opts: Calling on Allah and asking Him

quiz.en: What do you say when you hear someone sneeze and praise Allah?
True or false? A Muslim makes du'aa only to Allah.

think.q: Which of these du'aas do you already say? Which one will you learn this week?
think.a: Pick one and practise it every day this week!

parents.summary: Dhikr (remembering Allah), du'aa (calling on Him), four phrases of dhikr, and du'aas for leaving home, the mosque, sleeping, waking and sneezing.
parents.tip: Pick one du'aa of the week and say it together at its moment.
